data.title: How to get your brand selected by AI and Agents? GEO in practice.
data.description: Exclusive B2B GEO seminar in Stockholm, co-hosted with Semrush, on making a brand visible and selected by AI search and agents. Speakers were Henrik Anderberg, Gabriel Ghavami and Gerald Murphy (Semrush), with a panel featuring Balder, Google and Volvo Group. The page said the event was full, with a waitlist.

data.title: How to get your brand loved by AI and Agents? GEO in practice
data.description: Exclusive breakfast seminar, co-hosted with Semrush, introducing GEO and how to make a brand visible and recommended by AI and agents. Speakers were Henrik Anderberg, Gabriel Ghavami and Semrush's Gerald Murphy, followed by a panel with SKF, Balder and Volvo Group.

data.title: How do you get your brand loved by AI and Agents?
data.description: Breakfast seminar on how AI search and LLMs are changing B2B discovery, and what brands must do to be visible and recommended by AI and agents (GEO/AEO/AIO). It covered the move from SEO to GEO and what to measure, a GEO playbook, a roundtable, and optional mini-audit walkthroughs. Henrik Anderberg was the speaker.
